addis-ababa-science-and-technology-unive.name: Addis Ababa Science and Technology University
addis-ababa-science-and-technology-unive.summary: Addis Ababa Science and Technology University is one of Ethiopia's two specialised science and technology universities, established under the first Growth and Transformation Plan. It has colleges of engineering, natural and applied sciences, and social science and humanities, with departments ranging from architecture, civil, chemical, electromechanical, mining and software engineering to biotechnology, industrial chemistry, geology and food science.

injibara-university.name: Injibara University
injibara-university.summary: Injibara University is a public university in Injibara, Awi Zone of the Amhara region. It offers 58 undergraduate programmes in seven colleges and a School of Law, and 44 postgraduate programmes including a PhD in Developmental Psychology.

bonga-university.name: Bonga University
bonga-university.summary: Bonga University is a public university in Bonga, the historic centre of the Kafa coffee-growing area, and offers a distinctive PhD in Coffee Science and Technology. Its homepage reports 58 programmes and about 6,400 students across colleges of business, engineering, agriculture, natural sciences, health, social sciences, and continuing and distance education.

borana-university.name: Borana University
borana-university.summary: Borana University is a public university in Yabelo, Borana Zone of Oromia, with the motto “Dedicated to Resilient Pastoral Future”. It focuses on pastoral and dryland studies alongside engineering, business, natural sciences, social sciences, veterinary medicine and law, and has an extension site in Moyale.
